Origin and meaning

With Spanish origins, Diego is usually read as “supplanter (form of James)”.

About the name Diego

The Spanish form of James, made famous by the artist Diego Velázquez.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “supplanter (form of James)”, a Diego calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
